changeSet.author: codex
changeSet.comment: Ensure local/dev fixture users always have canonical customer profiles.
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO customer_profile ( user_id, rating_average, rating_count, completed_orders_count, canceled_orders_count, dispute_count, no_show_count, created_at, updated_at ) SELECT handy_user.id, 0.00, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP FROM handy_user WHERE handy_user.email IN ( 'customer@handynest.dev', 'performer@handynest.dev', 'admin@handynest.dev' ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM customer_profile existing WHERE existing.user_id = handy_user.id );
